nodes.label: Sprint 4 — Core Data Model and Lifecycle API
nodes.norm_label: sprint 4 — core data model and lifecycle api

nodes.label: Knowledge Governance Platform
nodes.rationale: Core proposition: structured, governed, API-expressed records consumed equally by humans and AI agents. No privileged path.

nodes.label: Lifecycle State Machine
nodes.rationale: draft → submitted → confirmed → deprecated; returned loop; confirmed → retired admin-only. Versioned via record_id + version identity pattern.

nodes.label: No Machine Can Confirm
nodes.rationale: Absolute rule: no agent credential, API key, or automated process may call a confirm endpoint. Enforced at confirm endpoints regardless of credential scopes. Phased mechanical enforcement: Sprints 4-9 rely on OIDC JWT requirement; Sprint 10 adds explicit agent: prefix check returning HTTP 403.

nodes.label: Domain Scoping and Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Domains are org subdivisions within a tenant. Contributors scoped to assigned domains; Admins implicit on all. Application-enforced at write time; not a DB FK.

nodes.label: Self-Review Prohibition
nodes.rationale: Contributors cannot confirm or return their own content. Admin break-glass allows self-confirm with mandatory justification + self_confirmed_by_admin flag + audit log entry.

nodes.label: Ingestion Pipeline
nodes.rationale: 3 source types: PDF (PyMuPDF), HTML (Playwright), JSON. Iterative operator model — small batches, repeated section selection. Triage/extraction split with human review gate (§11.5a). Workers use ARQ + Redis with mandatory startup hook.

nodes.label: Triage/Extraction Human Review Gate
nodes.rationale: Triage (cheap model) classifies chunks and produces estimate lists. Human reviews/corrects estimates before extraction (expensive model) runs. Decouples cheap classification from expensive per-candidate extraction. Introduced in v4.6.

nodes.label: Review Queue and Claiming
nodes.rationale: Filtered view (no dedicated table). Advisory claims with 48h expiry. Self-organising — any qualified reviewer can act. Admin break-glass for small teams. Claim expired by ARQ cron every 15 min.

nodes.label: Machine Auth — API Keys and Agent Roles
nodes.rationale: Sprint 10. bp_ prefixed keys, SHA-256 hash storage. agent: role prefix distinguishes machine from human. Synthetic User record per API key allows CurrentUser dependency unchanged. OIDC client credentials also supported via Authentik.
nodes.norm_label: machine auth — api keys and agent roles

nodes.label: Audit Log
nodes.rationale: Append-only, JSONB detail column. v1 events: break_glass_confirm, api_key_created, api_key_revoked. Generic schema avoids migration per new event type.

nodes.label: Hybrid Search with pgvector
nodes.rationale: 60/40 semantic/fulltext hybrid. Embeddings async via ARQ on record confirm. pgvector column dimension fixed at schema creation — changing models is a breaking migration. Graceful degradation when embeddings absent.

nodes.label: ARQ Resumability via Application Checkpoints
nodes.rationale: ARQ does not natively resume partially-executed jobs. Application implements chunk_status checkpoints. Worker startup hook resets processing chunks to queued — mandatory, load-bearing, must not be removed.

nodes.label: Schema-Per-Tenant Multi-Tenancy
nodes.rationale: Hard isolation at DB layer. Forward bet on SaaS optionality. Single-tenant v1 complexity accepted to avoid retrofitting multi-tenancy later.

nodes.label: Prompt Contracts
nodes.rationale: Prompts as code, not config. Version-controlled markdown files under prompts/ingestion/. Strict output schema, embedded known-good example, explicit invent-prohibition, no em dashes. Operator-editable prompts deferred to v1.1.

nodes.label: TEST_REVISED Process
nodes.rationale: Tests immutable by default. AI prohibited from modifying tests to make them pass. TEST_REVISED marker required on any authorised test change with rationale. Prevents silent weakening of access control assertions.

nodes.label: Record Taxonomy (Tasks, Workflows, Principles)
nodes.rationale: v4.4 dissolved Facts/Concepts as independent governed records — now TEXT[] on tasks. Tasks are atomic governed procedure units. Workflows compose tasks + principles. Principles are foundational document-grain knowledge.

nodes.label: Versioned Identity Pattern
nodes.rationale: id (specific version UUID) + record_id (stable across versions) + version (incrementing int). record_id ref columns are application-enforced not DB FK (record_id not unique across versions).

nodes.label: Human-in-the-Loop Governance
nodes.rationale: AI assists ingestion and search; humans confirm everything. The API is the product, UI is one consumer. Agents and humans are equal first-class API consumers with no privileged path.

nodes.label: API Keys Table Schema
nodes.rationale: bp_ prefix for secrets scanner detection. 288-bit entropy. SHA-256 hash storage only. last_used_at updated synchronously inline in v1.

nodes.label: Maps as Display Layer
nodes.rationale: Maps group Workflows within a Domain. Display-only — no governance lifecycle, no version. Reorganising Maps never triggers review cascade. UI-enforced authoring sequence: Maps before Workflows before Tasks.

nodes.label: Facts and Concepts Dissolved (v4.4)
nodes.rationale: Facts and Concepts removed as independently governed records. Per-record review overhead disproportionate to value. Now TEXT[] on tasks. Facts wrong in context means the task needs revision, not independent fact record.

nodes.label: Break-Glass Admin Confirm
nodes.rationale: Admin can confirm own content as break-glass. Requires non-empty justification. Sets self_confirmed_by_admin flag. Audit log entry written. UI scar displayed on confirmed record.

nodes.label: ingestion_triage_estimates Table
nodes.rationale: Stores candidate estimate list from triage LLM. One row per expected candidate. Operator reviews: correct types, discard, merge. Approve moves chunk to extraction_queued.

nodes.label: JSON Import Schema (v1.0)
nodes.rationale: Governs POST /api/v1/ingestions/json. Envelope with schema_version + items array. Task and Principle objects. task_order cross-reference validation. No partial imports. Not same schema as pipeline-internal candidate JSON.

nodes.label: CI Auto-Fix Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Event-driven GitHub Actions on CI failure. GLM-5.1 via synthetic.new. Fork gate + branch name validation. Path-traversal-safe allowlist restricts writes to api/, tests/, cli/, workers/, pyproject.toml.

nodes.label: Embedding Generation Worker
nodes.rationale: ARQ job triggered on record confirm. OpenAI-compatible embedding API via httpx. pgvector CAST(:embedding AS vector) — not ::vector cast (asyncpg rejects syntax). Async, confirmation not blocked.

nodes.label: Notifications System
nodes.rationale: In-app bell + optional SMTP. Kind values stable from v1 for future preference config. ARQ retries 3x with backoff on delivery failure. User preferences deferred to v1.1.

nodes.label: System Settings Store
nodes.rationale: DB-backed key/value store. LLM API keys stored Fernet-encrypted, never returned via API. Per-job resolver loads settings at job start — LLM config changes take effect without worker restart. DB values override env vars.

nodes.label: Absolute Rules
nodes.rationale: 5 absolute rules: no direct DB access outside core service, no machine can confirm, imports never create confirmed records, tests not modified to make them pass, no floating dependencies.

nodes.label: Two-Directional Authoring and Governance
nodes.rationale: Top-down authoring (human: Domain → Workflow → Task) vs bottom-up governance (machine/audit: Tasks confirmed individually, Workflows reference confirmed records). The friction between directions is the quality gate — operators cannot ship workflows with unconfirmed tasks.
